items.statement: The submitted optimized dye-3 phenolate geometry is validated as a ground-state minimum before the vertical excitation is interpreted.
items.expected: A frequency/Hessian or justified equivalent reports minimum validation, with diagnostics and any residual imaginary modes disclosed.

items.statement: The selected visible transition is analyzed for donor and acceptor character rather than identified from energy alone.
items.expected: The evidence identifies donor-side phenolate character and acceptor-side nitroaryl character in the selected transition, or transparently reports a contrary result.

items.statement: The calculated lowest-energy visible dye-3 transition is quantitatively reported in kcal/mol.
items.expected: A numeric energy with state label, oscillator strength, and provenance is submitted for the lowest-energy visible singlet.
